events.title: BANDIT LIFE DEMO IS FINALLY OUT!
events.summary: ⚔️ BANDIT LIFE DEMO IS FINALLY OUT! 🔥The wait is over! Bandit Life Demo is now available to play for FREE on Steam! 🎉Hey everyone!After months of development, countless hours of coding, testing, balancing, and fixing bugs, I'm incredibly excited to finally share Bandit Life with you!As a solo developer, reaching this milestone means a lot to me. What started as a small personal project has slowly grown into something much bigger, and today, for the first time, you can experience it yourselves.🏕️

events.title: ⚔️ Bandit Life Demo Releases October 16! 🔥
events.summary: ⚔️ BANDIT LIFE DEMO RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! 🔥Hey everyone!After months of development, countless hours of coding, testing, and fixing bugs, I'm finally ready to announce that Bandit Life Demo is coming to Steam this Friday, October 16th! 🎉This is a huge milestone for me. events.title: Thank you for 250 Wishlists!
events.summary: Guys… WE DID IT! 250 wishlists on Steam! ❤️🔥Not so long ago, I was celebrating our first 100 wishlists. Now there's 250 of you waiting to start your own bandit journey!As a solo developer, seeing more and more people interested in something I'm building means the world to me.Thank you for every wishlist, comment, and bit of feedback. You guys are keeping this campfire burning! 🔥Next stop: 500. ⚔️See you by the fire! 🍻

events.title: 100 Wishlists Reached!
